Authentic Vietnamese food, mindful of allergies
Oct 2026 • Friends
I arrived in Vietnam with my friend and we were searching for a restaurant serving authentic Vietnamese restaurants.

We found the Taste of Saigon (it is a bit hidden so you have to look), and they offered a great selection of dishes.

I have very severe shellfish allergies, but they made sure to help me choose dishes that would not be an issue, and I really enjoyed my meal as a result.

I strongly recommend this restaurant!
